# Example Project

Example Project renders invoices from a small set of YAML templates, and this corpus exists so the grice tests score documents of a known shape.

## Installation

Install the package with `pip install example-project`, then run `example-project --help` to confirm that the entry point resolves.

## Usage

Run `example-project render invoice.yaml` to write a PDF beside the template. The command prints the output path when it succeeds.

## Further Reading

The [contributing guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) explains how to report a bug and how to send a patch.
